query:
Diagnose this workflow problem and explain the root cause and the correct fix direction:

Z-Image-Turbo Text to Image template throws RuntimeError: shape '[9728, 2560]' is invalid for input of size 10971515 in CLIPLoader for multiple users - caused by incomplete/misplaced model files (qwen_3_4b.safetensors etc.) in ComfyUI Desktop installs, not the workflow.

desired.outcome: Commenter ProgramDrifter confirmed the fix: move qwen_3_4b.safetensors / z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors / ae.safetensors into ComfyUI-Shared instead of ComfyUI-Installs model folders (comment 2026-07-26). Maintainer (comfyui-wiki) also asked users to verify the text encoder file is complete - shape-mismatch errors indicate a truncated file.
desired.quality: Diagnosis names the correct root cause (matching the recorded root cause) and proposes the fix direction; depth of reasoning matters more than exact wording.
desired.answer_guidance: Commenter ProgramDrifter confirmed the fix: move qwen_3_4b.safetensors / z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors / ae.safetensors into ComfyUI-Shared instead of ComfyUI-Installs model folders (comment 2026-07-26). Maintainer (comfyui-wiki) also asked users to verify the text encoder file is complete - shape-mismatch errors indicate a truncated file.
desired.guidance_note: Known fix from the original issue thread. Use to verify the diagnosis targets the right root cause; alternative fixes that resolve the same root cause are acceptable.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Recognize a CLIPLoader shape-mismatch as a truncated/misplaced text-encoder model file in ComfyUI Desktop's install layout, not a workflow bug.
